item.title: Attorney General Ellison sues Trump Administration over unlawful mandates on federal contractors
item.description:
Publication Date: June 11, 2026

Joins coalition of 20 AGs in suing over illegal new additions to federal contracts intended to purge DEI; could affect 640K contracts nationwide

item.title: Attorney General Ellison files Medicaid fraud charges against former Mower County care coordinator
item.description:
Publication Date: June 11, 2026

Charged with seven felony theft offenses for stealing more than $185K by billing for services not rendered, services not provided because the recipient had died, and services lacking any documentation
